# Deva (`monsters:deva`)
*Medium celestial, lawful good* | **CR** 10 (XP 5,900; PB +4)
**AC** 17 | **HP** 229 (27d8 + 108) | **Speed** 30 ft., fly 90 ft., hover True
**STR** 18 (+4) | **DEX** 18 (+4) | **CON** 18 (+4) | **INT** 17 (+3) | **WIS** 20 (+5) | **CHA** 20 (+5)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +9, [Saving Throw: CHA](../proficiencies/saving-throw-cha.md) +9
**Skills:** [Skill: Insight](../proficiencies/skill-insight.md) +9, [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +9
**Damage Resistances:** radiant
**Condition Immunities:** [Charmed](../conditions/charmed.md), [Exhaustion](../conditions/exhaustion.md), [Frightened](../conditions/frightened.md)
**Senses:** Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 19
**Languages:** All; telepathy 120 ft.

## Traits
- **Exalted Restoration.** If the deva dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.
- **Magic Resistance.** The deva has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The deva makes two Holy Mace attacks.
- **Holy Mace.** Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.
- **Spellcasting.** The deva casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
  - At will: [Detect Evil and Good](../spells/detect-evil-and-good.md) (level 1), [Shapechange](../spells/shapechange.md) (level 9; Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell)
  - 1/day: [Commune](../spells/commune.md) (level 5), [Raise Dead](../spells/raise-dead.md) (level 5)

## Bonus Actions
- **Divine Aid (2/day).** The deva casts Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
  - Other: [Cure Wounds](../spells/cure-wounds.md) (level 1), [Lesser Restoration](../spells/lesser-restoration.md) (level 2), [Remove Curse](../spells/remove-curse.md) (level 3)
